create_transformer_config: create a TransformerConfig dataclass with vocab_size, embedding_dim, num_layers, num_heads, and widening_factor
build_multihead_attention: build a MultiHeadDotProductAttention module with num_heads and num_hiddens_per_head for dot-product attention
generate_position_encoding: generate sinusoidal position encodings for a given sequence length and hidden size
embed_token_sequences: embed sequences of integer tokens with positional encodings using TransformerConfig
run_transformer_decoder: run a transformer decoder on target sequences with causal masking and return log_softmax logits
